import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();

        int[] inputA = new int[3];
        int[] inputB = new int[3];

        String[] lineA = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            inputA[i] = Integer.parseInt(lineA[i]);
        }

        String[] lineB = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            inputB[i] = Integer.parseInt(lineB[i]);
        }

        int[] inputA2 = Arrays.copyOf(inputA, inputA.length);
        int[] inputB2 = Arrays.copyOf(inputB, inputB.length);

        System.out.println(n - getLostMaxFast(inputA2, inputB2) + " " + getWonMaxFast(inputA, inputB));
    }

    public static int getWonMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[] wins = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int good = (i + 1) % 3;
            wins[i] = Math.min(inputA[i], inputB[good]);
            inputA[i] -= wins[i];
            inputB[good] -= wins[i];
        }
        return Arrays.stream(wins).sum();
    }

    public static int getLostMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[][] waysToLose = {{0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2}};
        List<int[][]> allWaysToLosePermutations = getPermutations(waysToLose);

        int maxLost = 0;

        for (int[][] permutation : allWaysToLosePermutations) {
            int[] losts = new int[3];
            int[] inputACopy = Arrays.copyOf(inputA, inputA.length);
            int[] inputBCopy = Arrays.copyOf(inputB, inputB.length);

            for (int[] wayToLose : permutation) {
                int lostAdd = Math.min(inputACopy[wayToLose[0]], inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]]);
                inputACopy[wayToLose[0]] -= lostAdd;
                inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]] -= lostAdd;
                losts[wayToLose[0]] += lostAdd;
            }

            int lostSum = Arrays.stream(losts).sum();

            if (lostSum > maxLost) {
                maxLost = lostSum;
            }
        }

        return maxLost;
    }

    public static List<int[][]> getPermutations(int[][] array) {
        List<int[][]> permutations = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(array, 0, permutations);
        return permutations;
    }

    private static void permute(int[][] array, int start, List<int[][]> permutations) {
        if (start == array.length - 1) {
            int[][] copy = new int[array.length][];
            for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
                copy[i] = Arrays.copyOf(array[i], array[i].length);
            }
            permutations.add(copy);
        } else {
            for (int i = start; i < array.length; i++) {
                swap(array, start, i);
                permute(array, start + 1, permutations);
                swap(array, start, i);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void swap(int[][] array, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }
}
